content: {"like": ["Enjoyable mix of sci‑fi action, police procedural and domestic family drama giving the show a unique flavor and identity.", "Good use of live actors with model work, creating a lived‑in universe with natural dialogue and nice background details.", "Strong performances by the cast, especially Patrick Brogan, Haldane, and Jane Castle, with engaging banter and character development."], "dislike": ["Poor scheduling and limited airtime, which contributed to the show’s short run of only one season.", "Unclear marketing and genre confusion, being too hard‑edged for kids and too silly for adults.", "Lack of a proper first episode to set up the show and its plot."]}
